thread:
Harper Nguyen: Need a clean asset playbook for next week's webinar. Single-slide hero + three mini benchmark cards + one lead-routing diagram. Final deliverables: Figma frames, export pkg (PNG @2x, SVG), PPTX slide, and a one-page sales PDF. Low-fi comps first please.

Riley (design-ops): I can take this. ETA for first comps: 36 hours. Which metrics do we want on the mini cards and any strict copy constraints?

Zoe (content): Suggested cards: Latency, Cost-per-1k, Reliability. Short copy below (can tighten):
- Latency: "p95 latency about 20ms (typical)"
- Cost: "Unit cost about $0.10 / 1k tokens (typical)"
- Reliability: "Target SLA 99.9%"
Hero headline variants: A) "Cut inference spend without sacrificing speed" B) "Predictable latency for production LLMs"

Tom (demand-gen): Social crops needed: 1080x1080, 1200x628, and a LinkedIn banner 1920x600. Also request a 3-frame GIF (tile reveal) for paid. Motion layers in Figma pls.

Riley (design-ops): Noted. Brand tokens per kit: primary #0A74FF, accent #0B6FD8, bg #F4F7FB. Accessibility: contrast >=4.5:1, headers 22px semibold, body 14px. I will add dark-mode variants. Exports: hero 1920x1080, cards 1080x1080 + 1200x628, PPTX slide, PDF.

Kai (sales-ops): For routing diagram, map: CTA (gated) -> form (work email?) -> segmentation rules -> CRM tag -> queue notify. Rule example: if company_size >= 250 -> enterprise_queue else inbound_queue. Notify channel #leads-webinar and email sales-ops@redwood.com. Include CSV export cols: ts,email,company,company_size,route_tag,utm.

Legal Bot: Quick compliance note 3A avoid absolute promises on price/latency. Use qualifiers like "typical" or "about." Add required privacy line on gated form: "By registering you agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference. See https://redwood.com/privacy." Tag me in Figma comments for signoff.

Harper Nguyen: Good catch. Zoe will soften language and provide alt text + localization in EN/FR/DE/ES.

Zoe (content): I'll post localized overlays and alt text in this thread within 8 hours. Social subheads need to be <=25 chars.

Riley (design-ops): Plan: drop Figma frames to /marketing/launch/playbook (I will post the link). First comps = static PNGs + annotated frames showing motion layers. Optional GIF after copy/legal signoff. Will attach checklist in Figma: hero x2 headlines, 3 cards, routing slide, export package, alt text, localization CSV.

Tom (demand-gen): Paid spec note: GIF max 2s, muted BG variant with white overlay copy for ad platforms. Please keep file weight low for quick upload.

Kai (sales-ops): Add a one-line CRM mapping table on the routing slide (tag -> owner queue -> SLA expected). Also include a small note about PII handling for ops.

Riley (design-ops): Will include CRM mapping and PII note on the PDF summary. Owners: Riley = design; Zoe = copy/localization; Tom = paid QA; Kai = routing; Legal Bot = compliance.

Harper Nguyen: Thanks team. Ping this thread when Figma is up and I'll route to webinar partner for final schedule. :rocket:
